description: Reports whether TEE verification inputs are configured for this MCP Worker. It does not probe an enclave or verify a current attestation; use claim-specific verification and receipt evidence before relying on a TEE claim.
name: yax_get_attestation

configured.description: Whether an expected TEE measurement is configured.

expected_hash_configured.description: Whether a non-empty expected measurement exists; this is not an observed enclave hash.

ok.description: True when the configuration projection was produced.

verified.description: Always false because this tool performs no runtime or attestation probe.
